        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def dbg(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    flat=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=flat.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    print('bg',bg,'sepR',sep_rows,'sepC',sep_cols)
